summary.zh: 绘制架构图、流程图和关系图
summary.en: Draw architecture, flow and relation diagrams

description.zh: 覆盖架构图、流程图、时序图、数据流、状态机和组织架构等常见图示，可切换深浅两套主题。输出深色与浅色 SVG，以及各自的 2 倍 PNG。导出 PNG 需要本机有 bun 或 npx。
description.en: Covers architecture, flow, sequence, data flow, state machine and org charts, with switchable dark and light themes. Outputs a dark and a light SVG plus 2x PNGs of each. Exporting PNGs needs bun or npx on the machine.
